mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agents ( uuid, external_id, workspace_uuid, created_by_api_key_uuid, current_version, name, description, system, model, mcp_servers, metadata, multiagent, skills, tools, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, 1, #{params.Config.Name}, #{params.Config.Description,sensitive=true}, #{params.Config.System,sensitive=true}, CAST(#{params.Config.Model,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.MCPServers,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Multiagent,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Skills,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Tools,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING

INSERT INTO agent_versions ( external_id, workspace_uuid, agent_uuid, agent_external_id, version, name, description, system, model, mcp_servers, metadata, multiagent, skills, tools, agent_created_at, agent_updated_at, archived_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.AgentUUID}, #{params.AgentExternalID}, #{params.Version}, #{params.Config.Name}, #{params.Config.Description,sensitive=true}, #{params.Config.System,sensitive=true}, CAST(#{params.Config.Model,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.MCPServers,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Multiagent,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Skills,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), CAST(#{params.Config.Tools,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.AgentCreatedAt}, #{params.AgentUpdatedAt}, #{params.ArchivedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE agents SET current_version = #{params.CurrentVersion}, name = #{params.Config.Name}, description = #{params.Config.Description,sensitive=true}, system = #{params.Config.System,sensitive=true}, model = CAST(#{params.Config.Model,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), mcp_servers = CAST(#{params.Config.MCPServers,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), metadata = CAST(#{params.Config.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), multiagent = CAST(#{params.Config.Multiagent,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), skills = CAST(#{params.Config.Skills,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), tools = CAST(#{params.Config.Tools,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING
